# Chris Ng — DevOps Portfolio

> Portfolio of Chris Ng, a DevOps Lead and System Architect specializing in Kubernetes, GitOps, CI/CD pipelines, platform engineering, and production cloud infrastructure.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://chris-ng-1987.github.io/portfolio/): Profile, featured projects, technical skills, publications, awards, and contact links.
- [DevOps Lifecycle](https://chris-ng-1987.github.io/portfolio/devops-lifecycle.html): The CNCF-oriented toolchain used across plan, code, build, test, release, deploy, operate, and monitor.
- [DevOps Workflow](https://chris-ng-1987.github.io/portfolio/workflow.html): End-to-end workflow for application teams, from git push to production with GitOps.
- [CI/CD Pipeline](https://chris-ng-1987.github.io/portfolio/pipeline.html): Pipeline architecture with reusable GitLab CI templates, multi-environment deployments, and quality gates.
- [ArgoCD GitOps](https://chris-ng-1987.github.io/portfolio/argocd.html): Declarative multi-cluster, multi-environment continuous delivery with ArgoCD.
- [Kubernetes Components](https://chris-ng-1987.github.io/portfolio/k8s-components.html): Production Kubernetes platform components across monitoring, service mesh, security, storage, and GitOps.

## Open source

- [rancher-huawei-fusioncompute-node-provider](https://github.com/chris-ng-1987/rancher-huawei-fusioncompute-node-provider): Apache-2.0 Rancher node driver and Vue 3 UI extension for provisioning Kubernetes nodes on Huawei FusionCompute.

## Written work

- [An easier way to optimize Kubernetes resources for PHP application](https://medium.com/scmp-inside-the-wonton/an-easier-way-to-optimize-kubernetes-resources-for-php-application-2615a01aeb22): SCMP Inside the Wonton technical article (2024).
